descriptions.en: Loki camouflages himself, becoming invisible to enemies.
descriptions.zh: Loki伪装自身，让自己在敌人面前隐形。

descriptions.en: Launch a large particle of charged antimatter that will detonate on contact. Direct the particle by aiming, shoot it to charge it further. Deals <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>Blast Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect.
descriptions.zh: 发射一颗大型充能反物质粒子，触碰即引爆。通过瞄准来控制粒子方向，射击以进一步充能。造成 <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>爆炸伤害，并必定造成异常状态。

descriptions.en: Primes all enemies in an expanding radius with volatile antimatter. Press the ability to slow down enemy movement, hold the ability to speed them up.
descriptions.zh: 使用不稳定的反物质对一个不断扩大的范围内的所有敌人进行填充。按下技能键可减缓敌人移动速度，长按则加快其移动速度。

descriptions.en: Creates antimatter particles that orbit Nova and attack nearby targets. Each active particle reduces damage to Nova's Health and Shields.
descriptions.zh: 创造反物质粒子环绕 Nova 四周，并自动攻击邻近目标。每个处于活动状态的粒子都会减少对 Nova 的生命值和护盾造成的伤害。

descriptions.en: Creates a wormhole allowing instantaneous travel. Hold the ability to visualize placement.
descriptions.zh: 创造一个虫洞以实现瞬间移动。长按此技能可预览放置位置。

descriptions.en: Creates a localized storm of punishing explosions.
descriptions.zh: 在指定区域中制造出一阵局部轰炸风暴。

descriptions.en: Launches a plodding missile capable of unleashing a massive explosion.
descriptions.zh: 发射出一枚能造成大规模爆炸的慢速导弹。

descriptions.en: Vents out the Archwing's propulsion core, confusing enemy projectiles and causing them to detonate.
descriptions.zh: 将曲翼推进器核心中的气体排出，混淆并使敌方导弹引爆。

descriptions.en: Fires a high-yield, remotely detonated explosive projectile capable of latching onto targets.
descriptions.zh: 发射出一枚可附着在目标上并遥控引爆的高效爆裂物。

descriptions.en: The Warframe emits a massive pulse of energy, stunning nearby enemies and sending them flying.
descriptions.zh: 战甲放出巨大的能量脉冲，晕眩并击飞附近的敌人。

descriptions.en: Forms a protective energy shell around the Warframe
descriptions.zh: 形成一个围绕并保护着战甲的能量护罩。

descriptions.en: Drops flare beacons confusing incoming guided missiles.
descriptions.zh: 放出可以混淆敌方导弹接近的热诱弹。

descriptions.en: Fires a large volley of homing missiles.
descriptions.zh: 连续发射大量导弹。

descriptions.en: The Itzal Archwing teleports a short distance, dropping all enemy target locks.
descriptions.zh: 刺影曲翼瞬移一小段距离，尽数甩开锁定了目标的敌人。

descriptions.en: Activates a cloaking field that hides the Warframe and any nearby allies who remain stationary.
descriptions.zh: 展开一道隐形力场，使静止于力场中的战甲与友军隐匿行踪。

descriptions.en: Deploys drones that fight alongside the Warframe, each detonating in a destructive blast when killed.
descriptions.zh: 部署数台无人战机于战甲身旁进行战斗，当无人战机被破坏时会造成毁灭性的爆炸。

descriptions.en: Forms a miniature black hole that sucks in all nearby objects before rupturing in a massive shock wave.
descriptions.zh: 形成一个会吸进附近所有物体的微型黑洞，并在最后爆裂造成大规模的冲击震波。

descriptions.en: Cosmic Crush Augment: The black hole saps the area of heat, freezing enemies in range. Enemies near the black hole are completely frozen for |val|s.
descriptions.zh: 星体震荡强化：黑洞可以削弱范围内的热能并完全冻结附近的敌人 |val| 秒。

descriptions.en: Channeling all of her acoustic energy into the environment, Banshee uses ultrasonic reverberations to violently shake the ground.
descriptions.zh: Banshee 将她所有的声音能量传导至周遭环境，使用超声波反响剧烈撼动目标区域的地面。

descriptions.en: Banshee emits a sonic shockwave that pushes targets in range with enough force to incapacitate or kill attackers.
descriptions.zh: Banshee 释放一道音波冲击波，将范围内的敌人击退，使其失去战斗力并降低他们的护甲。

descriptions.en: Using Silence surrounds Banshee in an aura that stuns enemies and will limit their perceptions and tactical response to gunfire and Warframe attacks.
descriptions.zh: 使用静音会使 Banshee 笼罩在一层光环之中，该光环会眩晕敌人，限制其对枪声和战甲攻击的感知及战术反应，并使他们无法激活自身的技能。

descriptions.en: Using acoustic location, Banshee's Sonar power finds and tracks enemies, and exposes critical weak spots to everyone in your squad.
descriptions.zh: Banshee 的声纳技能可以利用声波进行定位，借以侦测及追踪敌人，并使队伍成员发觉敌人身上暴露出的致命弱点。

descriptions.en: Valkyr hurls forth a hook and pulls herself to whatever it hits. If it hits an enemy, nearby foes are pulled in as she unleashes a coordinated Melee attack.
descriptions.zh: Valkyr 发射钩索，将自己拉向命中的目标点。如果钩索命中敌人，则附近的敌人也会被拉向目标点，同时 Valkyr 会发动一次连携近战攻击。

descriptions.en: Valkyr lets out a rallying cry that bolsters Armor and Attack Speed for allies while in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range.
descriptions.zh: Valkyr 发出激励式咆哮， 为 <AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围内的友军增强护甲和攻击速度。

descriptions.en: Valkyr bares her deadly claws, unleashing devastating attacks that also heal her. Valkyr becomes immune to Status Effects and her Armor bonus from Warcry is multiplied while using the claws.
descriptions.zh: Valkyr 露出致命的利爪，释放毁灭性攻击的同时治疗自身。Valkyr 在使用利爪时免疫异常状态，且通过咆哮获得的护甲翻倍。

descriptions.en: Unleash a damaging blast, slowing its victims while increasing their Melee Damage Vulnerability.
descriptions.zh: 释放一道破坏性的冲击波使敌人减速，并使其受到的近战伤害增加。

descriptions.en: When activated, this power stores damage caused by guns. When triggered again, that damage is channelled through the next gunshot.
descriptions.zh: 启动时，这个技能会储存枪支造成的伤害。当再次启动，储存的伤害会导引至下一次射击。

descriptions.en: With intense focus, Mesa draws her Regulator pistols, shooting down her foes in rapid succession.
descriptions.zh: 在极度的专注之下，Mesa 以她的监察者双枪，对敌人快速地连续射击。

descriptions.en: Envelops Mesa in a barrier of energy, reflecting back incoming bullet damage.
descriptions.zh: Mesa 笼罩在能量障壁之中，反射来袭的子弹伤害。

descriptions.en: Gives an ally Extra Damage while jamming the guns of nearby enemies. This power shifts between team members.
descriptions.zh: 为队友增加额外伤害，同时干扰附近敌人的枪支运作。这个能力会在队伍成员之间转移。

descriptions.en: Release a fiery projectile that ignites enemies on contact.
descriptions.zh: 释放一个燃烧的投射物，点燃接触到的目标。

descriptions.en: Slam the ground to create a wave of incinerating plasma that knocks back enemies and strips their armor.
descriptions.zh: 猛击地面以产生一道焚化的等离子波来将敌人击退并剥去他们的护甲。

descriptions.en: Stun nearby enemies with strong accelerant. Increases all fire damage dealt.
descriptions.zh: 施放强力助燃可以眩晕邻近敌人，并提升对其造成的火焰伤害。

descriptions.en: Blast nearby foes with a burst of fire, and follow that up with a barrage of fireballs against any enemy who dares approach. Over time, these fireballs burn hotter as they consume more energy.
descriptions.zh: 用猛火爆发燃烧附近的敌人，并随之用一连串的火球打击胆敢靠近的敌人。随着时间的推移，火球将燃烧得更猛烈，也消耗更多能量。

descriptions.en: Emit a bright flash of light, blinding all nearby enemies.
descriptions.zh: 释放一道明亮的闪光，致盲附近所有的敌人。

descriptions.en: Radial javelins impale nearby enemies, inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.
descriptions.zh: 发射广域标枪刺穿附近的敌人，造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。

descriptions.en: Slash and dash through enemies alongside a radial specter. The powerful Exalted Blade’s slashes inflict <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.
descriptions.zh: 随着残影对敌人进行冲刺斩击。强大的显赫刀剑斩击造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。

descriptions.en: Excalibur launches into the air, jumping 3x higher than normal.
descriptions.zh: Excalibur 向上弹射到空中，其跳跃高度是一般跳跃的三倍。

descriptions.en: Summons a treacherous landslide of ice that instantly freezes and shatters all enemies in its radius.
descriptions.zh: 唤来变化莫测的雪崩，瞬间冻结并粉碎范围内的所有敌人。

descriptions.en: Frost deep freezes any vapor and moisture in the area, creating a protective sphere with brief invulnerability to boost its strength.
descriptions.zh: 冻结周围所有水气与水分，制造出能用来防御的球形冰罩；冰罩生成时有短暂的无敌时间，此时敌人对冰罩造成的伤害能强化冰罩的耐久度；在相同位置重复施放冰罩可强化其耐久度。

descriptions.en: Sends a wave of razor sharp, crystalized ice toward an enemy, dealing heavy damage.
descriptions.zh: 制造一道由锋利冰晶构成的冰浪来对敌人造成大量伤害及缓速效果。

descriptions.en: A frigid energy blast that freezes targets in their tracks.
descriptions.zh: 发射一道极度低温的能量来冻结目标。

descriptions.en: Mirage creates an entourage of doppelgangers to confuse and distract the enemy.
descriptions.zh: Mirage 创造随行的分身以混淆视听并引开敌人。

descriptions.en:
(TAP) Temporarily reduce the damage Mirage takes from enemies.
(HOLD) Temporarily increase Mirage's weapon damage.
descriptions.zh:
（短按）暂时减少敌人对 Mirage 造成的伤害。
（长按）暂时增加 Mirage 的武器伤害。

descriptions.en: Booby trap nearby objects while conjuring an irresistible jewel that bursts with radial blind when touched in darkness, or a radial explosion in light. Conjure multiple smaller jewels with the help of Hall of Mirrors.
descriptions.zh: 将附近物品变成诡雷的同时变出一个令敌人难以抗拒的宝石。在黑暗处触碰宝石会爆裂造成范围致盲，在光亮处则产生范围爆炸。通过镜厅的帮助能施放出数个小宝石。

descriptions.en: Fires an energy prism that shoots lasers in all directions. Activating again detonates the prism, blinding nearby foes.
descriptions.zh: 放出一个四处发射激光的能量球。再次激活此技能可以引爆炸弹，并致盲附近的敌人。

descriptions.en: Nyx releases a devastating psychic pulse, disorienting enemies in a wide radius and forcing them to turn on each other. Confused foes lash out at random factions.
descriptions.zh: Nyx 释放毁灭性的精神脉冲，使大范围内的敌人迷失方向，并迫使他们自相残杀。困惑的敌人会随机攻击不同派系。

descriptions.en: Nyx unleashes a volley of psychic bolts that track and strike nearby enemies with telekinetic precision. When enemies are slain, additional bolts scatter to new targets. Striking foes weakens their defenses and transfers a portion to Nyx.
descriptions.zh: Nyx 释放出一连串精神飞刃，通过意念操控来精准追踪并攻击附近的敌人。击杀敌人后，额外的飞刃会散射到新的目标上。命中敌人会削弱他们的防御，并将一部分防御转移给 Nyx。

descriptions.en: Nyx seizes control of a target's mind, compelling them to fight for the Tenno cause. Controlled enemies have increased <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status Chance. When Nyx shoots them, they also have an increased Damage Multiplier.
descriptions.zh: Nyx 控制目标的思想，迫使他们为 Tenno 效力。被控制的敌人会增加 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射触发几率。当 Nyx 射击他们时，伤害倍率也会增加。

descriptions.en: Nyx draws in and contains the damage dealt to her and the damage confused enemies deal to each other then converts it into a devastating radial blast. Following the blast, she enters a brief invulnerable state and gains a Weapon Damage boost proportional to the absorbed damage.
descriptions.zh: Nyx 吸收对她造成的伤害，以及困惑的敌人之间造成的伤害，然后将其转化为一道毁灭性的范围爆炸。爆炸后，她将进入短暂的无敌状态，并根据吸收的伤害增加武器伤害。

descriptions.en: Decoy
descriptions.zh: 诱饵

descriptions.en: Lets forth a wave of energy, disrupting the projectile weapons of enemies in range and forcing them to revert to melee combat.
descriptions.zh: 释放一道能量波，解除范围内敌人的射击武器，迫使他们使用近战。

descriptions.en: Loki camouflages himself, becoming invisible to enemies.
descriptions.zh: Loki伪装自身，让自己在敌人面前隐形。

descriptions.en: Loki instantaneously swaps positions with a target, confusing the enemy.
descriptions.zh: Loki瞬间和目标交换位置，迷惑敌人。

descriptions.en:
(TAP) Enclose a target in a magnetic field that ensnares nearby enemies and deals damage over time. The field pulls Polarize Shards that orbited Mag and shrapnel into the deadly mix.
(HOLD) Mag surrounds herself in a magnetic field that absorbs ranged attacks and reflects damage back in a destructive cone.
descriptions.zh:
（轻按）将目标封闭在磁场中，在一段时间内困住附近的敌人，并对其造成伤害。该磁场会吸引环绕 Mag 运动的「护盾极化碎片」和飞溅的弹片进行致命混合。
（长按）Mag 将自己包裹在一个磁场中，吸收远程攻击，并在一个破坏性锥型域内返还伤害。

descriptions.en: Magnetize the bones of nearby enemies, causing them to collapse upon themselves.
descriptions.zh: 磁化附近的敌军的骨头，导致它们自我崩坏。

descriptions.en: Mag stuns enemies as she manifests a magnetic vortex. The vortex pulls in Polarize Shards and stunned enemies to place them directly in front of her.
descriptions.zh: Mag 所制造出的磁力漩涡会晕眩敌人。漩涡会将「护盾极化碎片」和被震晕的敌人拉近，并将他们放置在她面前。

descriptions.en: Emit an energy pulse that depletes enemy shields and armor as it restores ally shields. Debris left over from the pulse becomes Polarize Shards. Nearby Polarize Shards orbit Mag and cut enemies, inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effect.
descriptions.zh: 发射一道能量脉冲，在耗尽敌人护盾和护甲的同时恢复队友护盾。脉冲留下的碎片会形成「护盾极化碎片」。附近的「护盾极化碎片」会环绕 Mag 并切割敌人，造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。

descriptions.en: Casts a wave of Rift energy that damages hostiles while pushing enemies and allies out of Limbo's current plane of existence.
descriptions.zh: 释放一道裂隙能量波来伤害敌人，同时将敌人与队友从 Limbo 目前所在的位面中推出去。

descriptions.en: Pass over into the rift plane.
descriptions.zh: 遁入裂隙位面。

descriptions.en: A violent blast of Void energy tears open a pocket of rift plane which can sustain itself for a short period before collapsing in another lethal blast.
descriptions.zh: 借由虚空能量的猛烈爆炸撕开一个裂隙位面空间，此空间能短暂持续至下一次致命爆炸发生。

descriptions.en: Surges nearby Rift-bound enemies with Rift energy. When killed the Rift Surge is transferred to a nearby enemy outside the rift. Surged enemies that leave the Rift perform a radial Banish.
descriptions.zh: 用裂隙能量涌流冲击附近被裂隙困住的敌人。被击杀时裂隙涌流会被传递到涌流外的一名附近的敌人上。被涌流影响的敌人若离开裂隙，将会引起一个范围​​放逐。

descriptions.en: Summon shadow versions of vanquished enemies to fight alongside you for a short period.
descriptions.zh: 召唤战死敌人的幽影在短时间内一起作战。

descriptions.en: Forces fallen enemies around you to drop additional loot.
descriptions.zh: 亵渎亡者尸体，从中搜取额外物品。

descriptions.en: A blow so powerful, it turns the enemy's very soul into a deadly projectile, damaging all in its path. Enemies that survive the blow are Marked for Harvest and become one of Nekros' Shadows of the Dead if killed while marked.
descriptions.zh: 如此强烈的打击，把敌人的灵魂化为致命弹头，来杀伤其经过路线上的一切。在这一击中幸存下来的敌人会被标记以待收割，如果敌人在处于标记时被杀死，他就会成为 Nekros「亡者幽影」中的一员。

descriptions.en: Cast fear into the hearts of nearby enemies, causing them to run away in terror.
descriptions.zh: 将恐惧感深植周遭敌人心中，使他们于恐惧之中逃窜。

descriptions.en: Launches a spinning blade of pain, dealing high damage and impaling enemies to walls.
descriptions.zh: 掷出一枚旋转的手里剑，造成高伤害并把敌人钉在墙上。

descriptions.en: Project fierce Shadow Clones of Ash upon groups of distant enemies. Join the fray using Teleport. The Shadow Clones can be upgraded with mods.
descriptions.zh: 将 Ash 的凶猛影分身投入远处的敌群中。使用「瞬移」可以主动加入这场厮杀。幻影分身可通过 Mod 来升级。

descriptions.en: Drops a smoke bomb that stuns enemies and obscures their vision, rendering Ash invisible for a short time.
descriptions.zh: 扔出烟雾弹眩晕敌人并阻碍其视线，同时 Ash 进入短暂的隐身状态。

descriptions.en: Teleport to a target and perform a Finisher. If the finisher kills the target, Ash regains a portion of the energy spent.
descriptions.zh: 瞬移至目标并进行处决。如果处决击杀目标，将为 Ash 恢复一部分消耗的能量。

descriptions.en: Lifts enemies into the air and then hurls them down with conviction, removing their Armor. Enemies hit by this ability will grant Oberon additional Armor and have a chance to spawn a <HEALTH>Health Orb when they die.
descriptions.zh: 将附近的敌人迅速举到空中，然后将其狠狠摔下。被该技能击中的会为 Oberon 提供额外护甲，并在死亡时有几率掉落生命球。

descriptions.en: Generates a protective aura that grants bonus Armor to Oberon and his allies and restores allies’ Health over time. Healing is doubled while within the radius of Hallowed Ground.
descriptions.zh: 生成一道保护光环，为 Oberon 及其友军提供护甲加成，并持续恢复友军生命值。在「神圣领域」范围内，治疗效果翻倍。

descriptions.en: Focuses deadly energy within a target, dealing massive damage and removing all of its defenses, including Overguard. Enemies near the target also take a portion of the damage.
descriptions.zh: 将致命能量聚集于目标，造成巨大伤害并移除其所有防御，包括超宏防护。目标附近的敌人也会受到部分伤害。

descriptions.en: Sanctifies the ground around Oberon, inflicting <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage to all enemies within the radius. Also grants protection against Status Effects for Oberon and his allies.
descriptions.zh: 圣化 Oberon 周围的地面，对范围内的所有敌人造成 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射伤害。同时保护 Oberon 及其友军免受异常状态影响。

descriptions.en: Summon a tempest to rain down upon a target area.
descriptions.zh: 召唤暴风雨弹炮轰目标区域。

descriptions.en: Summon a creature from the depths. Its watery tentacles emerge from nearby surfaces to wreak havoc.
descriptions.zh: 召唤一只来自深海的生物。它的水之触手从四面八方席卷而来造成严重破坏。

descriptions.en: Become a water trap and drown unsuspecting enemies.
descriptions.zh: 用水漩涡淹没毫无防备的敌人。

descriptions.en: Crash through enemies in a ferocious wall of water.
descriptions.zh: 用凶猛的水墙冲垮敌人。

descriptions.en: Warframe punches the ground, dealing high damage to enemies in a small radius.
descriptions.zh: 战甲震击地面，在小范围内对敌人造成大量伤害。

descriptions.en: Rhino hardens his skin, insulating himself from all damage and gaining Overguard.
descriptions.zh: Rhino 硬化他的皮肤，隔绝一切伤害并获得超宏防护。

descriptions.en: Grants all nearby Warframes increased damage for a short duration.
descriptions.zh: 短时间内让所有附近的战甲提升伤害输出。

descriptions.en: Rhino charges towards a target, clobbering any in his path and goring his victim.
descriptions.zh: Rhino 向目标冲锋，击倒突进路径上的一切阻碍，并以犀角强烈顶击目标。

descriptions.en: Rhino stomps with force sufficient to disrupt time, tumbling enemies around him in stasis.
descriptions.zh: Rhino 的强力践踏可以扰乱时间秩序，将周围的敌人锁定在时间中。

descriptions.en: Saryn pollutes the atmosphere with a lethally poisonous mist that corrodes all enemies in range. Deals additional Damage to enemies under <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin and <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral effects.
descriptions.zh: Saryn 以剧毒之雾污染空气，腐蚀范围内的敌人。依据敌人所受到的毒素与病毒影响受到额外伤害。

descriptions.en: Inflicts target with <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage over time. Destroying the spore will spread it to nearby enemies.
descriptions.zh: 对目标造成 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR> 持续的病毒伤害；摧毁孢子时会扩散至邻近敌人身上。

descriptions.en: Shedding her skin like a snake, Saryn leaves a decoy behind to draw fire from enemies.
descriptions.zh: Saryn 脱落如蛇般的皮肤，在身后留下诱饵吸引敌人的火力。

descriptions.en: When active, melee strikes burst spores causing them to spread to nearby enemies.
descriptions.zh: 施放时，近战攻击会引爆孢子使其扩散到附近的敌人。

descriptions.en: Hold while airborne to hover Zephyr with reduced movement. From the air, tap to dash forward, or aim down to dive bomb enemies below.
descriptions.zh: 在空中按住技能键，来使 Zephyr 悬停并减慢移动速度。在空中时，轻按技能键来向前冲刺，或是瞄准地面对下方的敌人使出俯冲轰击。

descriptions.en: Create deadly tornadoes that seek out and engulf enemies. Tornadoes deal the elemental Damage Type they absorb the most. Shoot engulfed enemies to inflict extra damage. Hold for stationary tornadoes or tap for wandering ones.
descriptions.zh: 制造致命的「龙卷云风」，四处搜寻并吞没敌人。「龙卷云风」会造成它们所吸收最多的元素伤害类型。射击被吞没的敌人来造成额外伤害。长按制造固定不动的「龙卷云风」，轻按则制造游走的「龙卷云风」。

descriptions.en: Creates a wind shield around Zephyr, redirecting all incoming projectiles.
descriptions.zh: 围绕Zephyr生成一个风护盾，把所有射进来的子弹都偏转到其他方向。

descriptions.en:
Control the battlefield with masterful mines. Vauban's Tether-Flechette orb immobilizes and draws in enemies while launching deadly nails in all directions.

HOLD to launch a Vector-Overdrive pad that accelerates foes and allies alike in the pad's direction, increasing ally Movement Speed and Weapon Damage.
descriptions.zh:
用精妙的地雷掌控战场。Vauban 的桎梏飞掷丸能束缚并吸引敌人，同时向四面八方发射致命的飞镖。

按住即可发射矢量超载垫，为垫子方向上的敌我双方加速，并提升友军的移动速度和武器伤害。

descriptions.en:
Erect a containment field to capture enemies and suspend them in stasis, stripping their armor and granting it to Vauban and any allies within Bastille's field.

HOLD to collapse all Bastilles into a single damaging vortex.
descriptions.zh:
建立一个包围力场以捕获敌人使他们陷入停滞状态，剥离其护甲并将其转移给 Vauban 和「力场牢狱」范围内的所有友军。

长按技能键来使所有力场牢狱坍塌成为一个破坏性旋涡。

descriptions.en: Creates a whirling mass of energy that violently attracts nearby enemies, crushing their atoms into a tiny spec of matter.
descriptions.zh: 创造一个大规模旋转的能量，猛烈牵引附近敌人，粉碎他们的原子成微小物质。

descriptions.en: Deploy a roller drone that attaches itself to enemies and delivers bursts of arcing <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR> Electricity Damage to anything in the immediate area.
descriptions.zh: 部署一架可以将自身附着在敌人身上的滚子无人机，并向附近区域的任何物体发出炸裂电弧，造成 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害。

descriptions.en: Restore the health and shields of allies within <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range while reducing the damage they take from enemies.
descriptions.zh: 恢复 <AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围内友军的生命值和护盾，同时减少他们受到的敌人伤害。

descriptions.en: Allies will gain energy over time when enemies are marked with Energy Vampire.
descriptions.zh: 友军将在伤害被能力吸取标记的敌人同时获得能量。

descriptions.en: Any damage taken while Link is active will be channeled to a nearby enemy.
descriptions.zh: 链接激活时，一切受到的伤害将转移给身边的一个敌人。

descriptions.en: Create a well of life on an enemy who will absorb Status Effect damage intended for nearby allies. Allies gain additional Health when they attack the target. If allies die, enemies in the well of life die in their stead.
descriptions.zh: 在敌人身上创造一道生命之井，吸收附近队友受到的异常状态伤害。队友攻击目标时可获得额外生命值。如果队友死亡，生命之井中的敌人将代替他们死亡。

descriptions.en: Volt discharges the electricity that courses through him. The shockwave paralyzes and damages nearby enemies. Enemies on the edge of the shockwave are stunned.
descriptions.zh: Volt 会释放流淌全身的电流。冲击波会麻痹并伤害附近的敌人。处在冲击波边缘的敌人则会被击晕。

descriptions.en:
Volt deploys an electric shield that blocks enemy fire and adds <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage to projectiles.
 
HOLD to equip the shield for mobile cover.
descriptions.zh:
Volt 部署一个电力屏障，能阻挡敌方火力，并对投射物附加<DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害。
 
长按可装备屏障，作为移动掩护。

descriptions.en: Launch a voltaic projectile that stuns and damages its target. A chain of electricity extends from the target to shock nearby enemies.
descriptions.zh: 发射一个能击晕并伤害目标的伏电射弹。一串电弧以目标为中心，散发式电击附近的敌人。

descriptions.en: Embody an electric current. Volt and his allies receive a brief movement speed boost and a reload speed buff.
descriptions.zh: 显现一支电流。Volt 与其队友会获得短暂的移动速度和装填速度增益。

descriptions.zh: 库狛嗅出被埋藏的道具并挖掘出来。

descriptions.zh: 在对敌人完成研究后，后续扫描将暴露出他们的弱点。

descriptions.en: Critical hits cause flowers to grow from the wounds.
descriptions.zh: 暴击伤害会使伤口中长出花朵。

descriptions.en: Fatal strikes against an enemy also perform a Codex Scan. Scans require an equipped Codex Scanner and an available charge.
descriptions.zh: 对一个敌人致死攻击同时也会进行资料库扫描。扫描需要携带一个资料库扫描器且有可用的扫描次数。

descriptions.en: Stopping cyber-crime in its tracks
descriptions.zh: 制止网络犯罪

descriptions.en: Your digital virus buster
descriptions.zh: 你的数字病毒克星

descriptions.en: There's no Clean like Keep-Clean
descriptions.zh: 没有任何清理能比得上持续清理。

descriptions.en: Keeps your bytes tight and your bits fit
descriptions.zh: 保持字节紧凑，确保比特精准

descriptions.en: Digital extremists stand no chance when you have Anti-V on your side
descriptions.zh: 有了防毒先锋的保护，数字极端分子就没有机会

descriptions.zh: 时刻监控，保障软件的安全

descriptions.en: Eliminating sneaky viruses since 1989
descriptions.zh: 自 1989 年以来一直在消灭潜伏病毒

descriptions.en:
To cosmic forms from tangent planes

We end as we began
descriptions.zh:
对于从相切位面演化出的宇宙来说

我们的结局又回到了开始

descriptions.en:
In luminous space blackened stars

They gaze, accuse, deny
descriptions.zh:
光明的太空之中，飘荡着焦黑的星辰

它们凝视、指责、否认

descriptions.en:
To cosmic madness laws submit

Though stalwart minds entreat
descriptions.zh:
面对疯狂的宇宙，法则选择了屈服

但那些坚定之人却前去乞求

descriptions.en:
From brooding gulfs are we beheld

By that which bears no name
descriptions.zh:
来自沉思之渊的视线，落在了我们身上

其源头为无名之物

descriptions.en:
Carrion hordes trill their profane

Accord with eldritch plans
descriptions.zh:
腐朽的大军以亵渎的口吻

吟唱着古老的计划

descriptions.en:
Roiling, moaning, this realm of ours

In madness lost shall die
descriptions.zh:
我们的世界，沸腾着，呻吟着

在癫狂之中，等待迷失者的只有死亡

descriptions.en:
Corporeal laws are unwrit

As suns and love retreat
descriptions.zh:
定律归零

太阳和爱退缩

descriptions.en:
Its heralds are the stars it fells

The sky and Earth aflame
descriptions.zh:
掉落的星辰是它到来的先兆

天地燃烧

descriptions.en:
Through endless faces, countless forms, a multitude unfolds.

(Mimics any Requiem Mod)
descriptions.zh:
通过无尽的面孔、无数的形态，呈现出千姿百态。

（可模拟任意安魂 Mod）
